title: Integrating activated carbon into conventional sand filtration boosts biological Mn(II) removal efficiency
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1861-1867
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00344J, Communication
Qi Chen, Bin Wu, Yuliang Su, Huidong Shen, Guohang Han, Shengtao Chen, Baoyou Shi, Guiwei Li
Partial GAC replacement in sand filters enables efficient biological Mn(II) removal, offering a low-cost, infrastructure-friendly solution for improving drinking water treatment performance.
